\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 232-235 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R240-first-pass-words-from-chapters-232-235}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for suitable and excellent.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item dizziness, an ointment, a surgeon, a crutch, bleeding
  \item since, dawn, sunrise, sunset, birth
  \item yearly, late morning, soon, an alarm clock, a calendar
  \item a museum, a stadium, a pavement; a platform, a crossroads, an embassy
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Dizziness? (\textbf{\ar{دوار}}, \emph{duwār}.) An ointment? (\textbf{\ar{مرهم}}, \emph{marham}.) A surgeon? (\textbf{\ar{جراح}}, \emph{jarrāḥ}.) A crutch? (\textbf{\ar{عكاز}}, \emph{ʿukkāz}.) Bleeding? (\textbf{\ar{نزيف}}, \emph{nazīf}.) Since? (\textbf{\ar{منذ}}, \emph{mundhu}.) Dawn? (\textbf{\ar{فجر}}, \emph{fajr}.) Sunrise? (\textbf{\ar{شروق}}, \emph{shurūq}.) Sunset? (\textbf{\ar{غروب}}, \emph{ghurūb}.) Birth? (\textbf{\ar{ميلاد}}, \emph{mīlād}.) Yearly? (\textbf{\ar{سنوي}}, \emph{sanawī}.) Late morning? (\textbf{\ar{ضحى}}, \emph{ḍuḥā}.) Soon? (\textbf{\ar{قريبا}}, \emph{qarīban}.) An alarm clock? (\textbf{\ar{منبه}}, \emph{munabbih}.) A calendar? (\textbf{\ar{تقويم}}, \emph{taqwīm}.) A museum? (\textbf{\ar{متحف}}, \emph{matḥaf}.) A stadium? (\textbf{\ar{ملعب}}, \emph{malʿab}.) A pavement; a platform? (\textbf{\ar{رصيف}}, \emph{raṣīf}.) A crossroads? (\textbf{\ar{تقاطع}}, \emph{taqāṭuʿ}.) An embassy? (\textbf{\ar{سفارة}}, \emph{sifāra}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 236-240 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R240-second-pass-words-from-chapters-236-240}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an earthquake and a flood.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an earthquake, a flood, ice, a citizen, inhabitants
  \item patience, generosity, a feeling, morals, personality
  \item like, completely, of course, almost, especially
  \item luck, an agreement, a discussion, a memory, doubt
  \item out of order, ready, genuine, suitable, excellent
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An earthquake? (\textbf{\ar{زلزال}}, \emph{zilzāl}.) A flood? (\textbf{\ar{فيضان}}, \emph{fayaḍān}.) Ice? (\textbf{\ar{جليد}}, \emph{jalīd}.) A citizen? (\textbf{\ar{مواطن}}, \emph{muwāṭin}.) Inhabitants? (\textbf{\ar{سكان}}, \emph{sukkān}.) Patience? (\textbf{\ar{صبر}}, \emph{ṣabr}.) Generosity? (\textbf{\ar{كرم}}, \emph{karam}.) A feeling? (\textbf{\ar{شعور}}, \emph{shuʿūr}.) Morals? (\textbf{\ar{أخلاق}}, \emph{akhlāq}.) Personality? (\textbf{\ar{شخصية}}, \emph{shakhṣiyya}.) Like? (\textbf{\ar{مثل}}, \emph{mithl}.) Completely? (\textbf{\ar{تماما}}, \emph{tamāman}.) Of course? (\textbf{\ar{طبعا}}, \emph{ṭabʿan}.) Almost? (\textbf{\ar{تقريبا}}, \emph{taqrīban}.) Especially? (\textbf{\ar{خصوصا}}, \emph{khuṣūṣan}.) Luck? (\textbf{\ar{حظ}}, \emph{ḥaẓẓ}.) An agreement? (\textbf{\ar{اتفاق}}, \emph{ittifāq}.) A discussion? (\textbf{\ar{نقاش}}, \emph{niqāsh}.) A memory? (\textbf{\ar{ذكرى}}, \emph{dhikrā}.) Doubt? (\textbf{\ar{شك}}, \emph{shakk}.) Out of order? (\textbf{\ar{معطل}}, \emph{muʿaṭṭal}.) Ready? (\textbf{\ar{جاهز}}, \emph{jāhiz}.) Genuine? (\textbf{\ar{أصلي}}, \emph{aṣlī}.) Suitable? (\textbf{\ar{مناسب}}, \emph{munāsib}.) Excellent? (\textbf{\ar{ممتاز}}, \emph{mumtāz}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
